notes: Held-out handwritten fixture. Same 12 documents as retrieval_cases_extended.json (the development set), new questions written after the development results. Use it only to report a cutoff chosen on the development set, never to tune one. insufficient_context questions share vocabulary with the corpus but the answer is not in it: retrieval scores alone are not expected to catch them.

documents.text: MCP conecta agentes a ferramentas de engenharia com contratos explicitos.
RAG recupera trechos de documentos para fornecer contexto ao modelo.
An outbox stores business changes and pending events in the same database transaction.
Observability uses traces and metrics to investigate latency and errors.
A inbox registra identificadores de eventos processados para evitar repetir efeitos locais.
Retries repeat transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter.
Uma dead letter queue recebe mensagens que esgotaram as tentativas de processamento.
Authentication verifies identity. Authorization decides access to a resource.
Caches precisam de prazo de validade e estrategia de invalidacao para dados alterados.
Um trace correlaciona spans de uma requisicao entre servicos.
Metric labels should use route templates rather than individual customer identifiers.
Um monolito modular define interfaces e impede dependencias ciclicas entre modulos.
